title: cuphea fruticosa var. megapotamica
intro: Cuphea fruticosa var. megapotamica, commonly known as Firecracker Plant, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Lythraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of Cuphea fruticosa var. megapotamica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
